title: Assembler 2, General
description:
Description:
At the Client Pharmaceutical Company, what matters most is helping all people live healthy lives.
We focus on treating, curing, and preventing some of the most devastating and complex diseases of our time. And we pursue the most promising science, wherever it might be found.
Our mission drives us. Our patients inspire us. We collaborate with the world for the health of everyone in it.
Thriving on a diverse company culture, celebrating the uniqueness of our employees, and committed to inclusion.
Proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
In this position the Essential Functions:
• Responsible for completing required documentation (such as batch records, returns, etc.).
• Possess a basic understanding of production processes within area of assignment and a working knowledge of manufacturing equipment.
• Operate equipment in accordance to applicable manufacturing instructions/ operating procedures including machine set-ups and parameter documentation.
• Follow GMP's and standard operating procedures.
• Follow process and utility flow diagrams.
• Transport materials of varying weight in accordance with established safety guidelines using material handling equipment and additional assistance as required.
• Perform area safety inspections to identify safety hazards and report findings in accordance with company protocols.
• Demonstrates adherence to safety procedures by monitoring personal and peer behaviors, work environment and housekeeping.
• Participate in internal audits and support additional team activities as requested.
• Participate on site investigative teams and where applicable, Client, s and behavioral safety assessments. Correct and/or mitigate findings from assessments.
• Available for overtime as needed
• Performs all duties with attention to quality, safety, and environmental matters such as wearing appropriate personal protective equipment, identifying, reporting, and appropriately responding to hazards in the work area (spills/accidents/near misses), maintaining proper housekeeping at all times, and properly labeling and storing chemicals.
• Carries out duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations and guidelines including FDA, ISO, and OSHA. Complies with all company and site policies and procedures.
• Assume responsibility for the environmental effects of work performed and for the identification and recording of environmental problems as they arise.
• Follow all applicable aspects of the site Environmental Management System as it pertains to normal job duties.
• Complete all regulatory training as assigned (GPM, s, ISO14001, OSHA, etc.).
• Complete Operator Training Program according to established guidelines.
• Be available for other projects or assignments as requested by management.
• Looking for ways to simplify or improve products, services, systems, and processes to achieve business goals, e.g., improve yield, cycle time, quality, and productivity.
• Makes a positive contribution through demonstration of ability to seek out assistance from co-workers as needed; to suggest ways to improve upon current operations practices and systems; and to learn new skills, procedures and processes

Qualifications
• High School Diploma/GED or 4 months of work experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
• Work experience in chemical, pharmaceutical, or industry that complies with GMP is highly preferred.
• Able to read, write, fluently English preferred.
• Operating skills of manufacturing equipment, tools, and hand/pallet jack is preferred.
• Basic Computer Skills preferred
• PC navigation such as the ability to enter data into programs/software applications as instructed and use software applications for mail, word processing, spreadsheets and other job specific needs preferred.
• Ability to communicate and effectively work as part of a team is required.

title: Prompt Engineer with LLM
description:
About the Role:
We are looking for native US English speakers with experience in working with Large Language Models (LLMs). The project involves watching YouTube videos and generating 2 to 4 complex queries per video along with golden answers — these should be questions that advanced models like Gemini 2.5 Pro are unlikely to answer correctly.

Project Description:
  • Review YouTube videos of varying lengths
  • Create 2–4 complex queries per video
  • Provide "golden answers” (high-quality, ground truth answers)
  • Focus is on creating edge cases that challenge advanced LLMs
  • Each video task is estimated to take ~30 minutes
  • Duration: 4 weeks
  • Weekend work may be required
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Language Proficiency: Native-level US English
  • Experience: 8+ years working with LLMs or in AI/ML data annotation/evaluation
  • Location: United States-based candidates only

title: Oracle Fusion SCM Manager
description:
As an Oracle Fusion SCM Advisor within a healthcare organization, you'll spearhead the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Oracle Fusion Supply Chain and Manufacturing (SCM) solutions. You'll align supply chain processes—spanning procurement, inventory, planning, and logistics—with healthcare-specific priorities such as regulatory compliance, patient safety, and cost control.
Key Responsibilities
· Lead full-cycle implementation or enhancement of Oracle Fusion SCM modules including Procurement (P2P), Order Management (O2C), Inventory/MFG, Planning, and Logistics.
· Conduct business requirements gathering and translate those into configuration designs that align with healthcare supply chain workflows—from vendor onboarding to supplies distribution and serialization.
· Administer supply chain application roles, manage setup artifacts, metadata, and enterprise structures in Oracle Fusion SCM. (Reflects tasks from Supply Chain Application Administrator roles).
· Enable and maintain REST/integration services for supply chain data exchange (e.g., change orders, inventory transactions). (Reflects Supply Chain Integration Specialist responsibilities) .
· Develop supply chain dashboards and analytics (e.g., OTBI/BI Publisher), tailored to healthcare metrics such as inventory turnover, waste reduction, order accuracy, and regulatory traceability.
· Collaborate cross-functionally with clinical teams, quality control, finance, and IT to ensure SCM systems support patient care delivery, compliance (FDA, HIPAA), and financial oversight.
· Provide end-user training, system documentation, and change management support to ensure smooth adoption of SCM solutions.
Essential Qualifications
· 7+ years in Oracle Fusion SCM implementation or advisory roles, with experience in at least two key modules (e.g., Procurement, Inventory, Planning).
· Expertise in Oracle SCM Cloud deployment, configuration and data/integration services.
· Strong knowledge of healthcare supply chains—especially medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or clinical supplies.
· Experience working within regulatory frameworks (FDA regulations, validations, serialization standards, etc.).
· Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills, with a track record in consulting or advisory settings.
Nice-to-Have
· Certifications in Oracle SCM Cloud or healthcare supply chain management.
· Familiarity with healthcare ERP (e.g., Epic, Cerner) integrations.
· Prior experience in the Bay Area healthcare environment.
· Project delivery expertise using Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Operator 2, Packaging Operations
description:
Description:
Responsible for the manual inspection, labeling, and packaging of clinical and commercial products. Perform finished product packaging as required to satisfy all customer, internal, clinical, and other demand. Ensure finished product is packaged in accordance with procedures and Quality specifications. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Required Skills:
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering (building and shipping software) with end-to-end lifecycle ownership, including leadership roles. You have contributed to application code, implemented new features, fixed bugs, and worked across the software lifecycle—from design and development to deployment and support.
  • Strong Full Stack Engineer – Java , J2ee , Spring, Struts , Hibernate.
  • Hands-on expertise in GitHub Enterprise: branching strategies, repository management, GitHub Actions, Packages, Advanced Security, and Org-level Administration.
  • Proven Release/ Change Management: versioning, readiness reviews, and rollout strategies, and Quality Engineering leadership: testing strategy and quality gates
  • Strong background in DevOps principles: CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, and observability.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong communication and leadership skills to influence across engineering and leadership teams.
About the Role
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep DevOps and GitHub expertise to architect, build, and own our software delivery ecosystem. You'll design and implement developer workflows, CI/CD automation, and platform tooling that empower our engineering teams to deliver, test, and deploy software rapidly and reliably.

What You'll Do
  • Enable Engineering Productivity
  • Introduce best practices for design and code reviews, automation, and collaboration.
  • Partner with engineering and operations to drive developer efficiency and reliability.
  • Lead training and documentation to ensure adoption across teams.
  • Lead Development Operations Architecture
  • Define the overall GitHub strategy, including repository structure, branching models, standards, and governance.
  • Establish scalable CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other DevOps tools.
  • Integrate testing, security, and compliance into every stage of the software lifecycle.
  • Integrate security and compliance to automate evidence and enforcement guardrails through pipelines
  • Implement safe rollout strategies with automated verification
  • Advance DevOps & Cloud Practices
  • Implement Terraform to configure the application layer.
  • Implement Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Ensure secure handling of secrets, access, and compliance requirements.
  • Build automated monitoring, alerting, and observability into systems.

  • o Monitor KPIs to drive improvements and continually remove delivery bottlenecks.

  • • Enable, Lead, and Mentor
  • o Coach delivery and engineering teams and influence leadership with roadmaps and defined business outcomes and KPIs/metrics

title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
The SAP SD Consultant is responsible for the design, implementation, and support of the SAP Sales and Distribution module. This role involves collaborating with business stakeholders to analyze and understand their business processes and requirements, and then translating those requirements into a functional and technical design within the SAP system. The consultant will be a key player in project life cycles, from initial blueprinting to go-live and post-implementation support.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Process Analysis & Requirements Gathering:
Work closely with business users and stakeholders to analyze complex sales and distribution business processes.
Identify and document business requirements, gaps, and issues.
Facilitate workshops to collect and validate requirements.

SAP SD Configuration & Implementation:
Design, configure, and customize the SAP SD module to meet business needs.
Configure key functionalities, including sales order processing, pricing, billing, shipping, and credit management.
Set up master data, such as customer and material master data.
Configure and manage pricing procedures, condition types, and access sequences.

Integration & Collaboration:
Ensure seamless integration of the SD module with other SAP modules, such as Materials Management (MM), Financial Accounting (FI), and Production Planning (PP).
Collaborate with other functional and technical teams (e.g., ABAP developers) to ensure a cohesive system and successful project delivery.

Testing & Troubleshooting:
Develop and execute test cases for unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Analyze and resolve software problems and system issues, acting as a liaison with the client for troubleshooting.
Perform system upgrades and enhancements to improve functionalities.

Support & Documentation:
Provide ongoing support to end-users for SAP SD-related queries and issues.
Create and maintain detailed documentation, including functional designs, configuration guides, and user manuals.
Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure they are proficient in the SAP system.

Continuous Improvement:
Proactively identify and propose business process and system enhancements.
Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP advancements, best practices, and industry trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: Proven experience as an SAP SD Consultant, with hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP implementation.

Technical Skills:
In-depth knowledge of the SAP SD module and its functionalities.
Proficiency in key SD components, including Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Shipping & Logistics Execution, and Credit Management.
Strong understanding of integration points with other SAP modules (FI, MM).
Basic knowledge of ABAP debugging is a plus.

Professional Competencies:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with stakeholders and document solutions.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to configuration and documentation.
Effective time management and the ability to handle multiple deliverables simultaneously.
